def VTask.bitCasesOn {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (n : ℕ) (bit : (b : Bool) → (m : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b m)) : motive n :=
match n with
| 0 => bit false 0
| Nat.succ k =>
  match k with
  | 0 => bit true 0
  | Nat.succ j =>
    match j with
    | 0 => bit false 1
    | Nat.succ l => bit true l
